description: Find pinball machines: "what Stern machines are in production right now?", "what pinball games has Stern made?", "pinball games from 1992". `in_production` filters to machines Kineticist lists as currently made. Searches and filters the Kineticist pinball game database. Supports text search, manufacturer filtering, year ranges, production status, and sorting. Returns game names, slugs, manufacturers, fun scores, edition counts, and each game's page URL on kineticist.com (link it when citing a game). `newest_edition_year` is the year the newest edition came out, not the year production ended; `in_production` says whether the game is still made.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

in_production.description: Filter to only games currently in production (true) or out of production (false)

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

manufacturer.description: Filter by manufacturer name or slug (fuzzy match — 'stern' works)

q.description: Part of the game's name (2+ chars), e.g. 'godzilla' or 'black knight'. When no name contains it, Kineticist search picks the closest games and `matched_by` and `note` say so; when nothing fits, `suggestions` names the closest games.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending. Options: name, first_manufacture_year (games from the same year are ordered by their earliest edition date, so -first_manufacture_year puts the newest release first), average_fun_score, ratings_count. Missing values sort last; average_fun_score puts games under 5 ratings last.

name: search_pinball_games
title: Search pinball games
